text:
anya: Noting a blindspot in the active-active design: when we allow temporary cross-region writes for latency reasons we need a deterministic escrow handshake to avoid split-brain. Quick proposal below, please poke holes.

anya: Escrow handshake (short):
1) client -> near region A with header X-Write-Escrow: true and idempotency_token
2) A creates provisional record (provisional=true) and returns 202 + X-Escrow-Id
3) A async forwards meta to resident region B (includes kms_key_ref, write_digest)
4) B validates residency and KMS region, if ok B writes durable record and ACKs escrow_id
5) A converts provisional->committed on ACK, emits escrow_committed audit, charge billing; if no ACK within hard_timeout -> provisional_failed + operator task

mara: Strong thumbs up on explicit provisional state. Questions: polling model for clients (how do they learn finality?), TTL for stranded escrows, and a default conflict policy (reject vs merge).

lee: Add: require signed consent token for cross-region writes; else 403. Add kms_key_id validation: if kms_key_region != resident_region -> reject unless operator_approved. Also include write_timestamp+origin_region to resolve concurrent writes deterministically.

olivia: Ops must show live failing escrows in UI and allow RETRY / FORCE_COMMIT / ROLLBACK. FORCE_COMMIT needs 2FA and reason_code. All actions must emit escrow_admin_action audit events. Also include X-Escrow-Id and X-Routing-Graph headers in responses.

anya: State machine proposal: PROVISIONAL -> FORWARDING -> COMMIT_PENDING -> COMMITTED | PROVISIONAL_FAILED -> ROLLED_BACK. Track last_attempt_ts and attempt_count. Soft_timeout (30s) triggers retry+notify, hard_timeout (5m) creates operator task. Sticky fallback: if >3 escrows in 10m, route tenant resident-first for 1h.

sam: Billing note: charge small upfront credit for provisional writes, finalize charge on commit. Emit billing_adjustment events on rollback. Also decision_version must be recorded to replay routing choices.

mara: For PII tenants default conflict policy = REJECT. For non-PII we can allow MERGE if application provides merge hook. Add dataset flags: cacheable_by_policy and pii_class (none|low|high).

lee: Telemetry: emit strings for escrow_created, escrow_forwarded, escrow_committed, escrow_failed, escrow_admin_action. Include escrow_id, tenant_id, decision_version, kms_region, reason_code. I'll prototype event proto.

olivia: Alerting: ops-bot, please create draft alert: escrow_failed_rate > 0.5% in 10m -> page SRE and create operator queue.`

ops-bot: ack: creating alert draft escrow_failed_rate > 0.005 (10m) -> page SRE, create incident ticket tag=escrow.

anya: Quick client visibles: reads return last committed value; provisional hidden unless client requests ?include_provisional=true with consent. Also GC provisional after 48h, operator notified before purge.

lee: Concurrent write tie-break: resident accepts commit if incoming.write_ts >= resident.version_ts OR origin_region == resident_primary. Otherwise returns conflict and preserves resident. Admin override token can force.

mara: Simulation plan: run 24h sim with 50k tenants, 5% residency constrained, inject random 10-30s partitions, measure escrow latency, forced admin actions, conflict rate. Tune soft/hard timeouts + sticky window.

anya: Actions: 1) I'll add an RFC appendix describing the escrow handshake and states. 2) @lee proto for telemetry + small harness. 3) @mara dataset metadata and conflict defaults. 4) @olivia header stubs + operator UI fields. 5) ops-bot flesh out alert and ensure audit retention.

sam: Default off for escrow; opt-in per-tenant via allow_escrow_writes=true + consent token. Thanks all :rocket:
